qa.label: QA/QC environment
qa.name: QA/QC
qa.description: Review documents and analytical results, manage deviations and CAPA, and release batches with your electronic signature.
qa.headline: Quality decisions backed by complete evidence

production.label: Production environment
production.name: Production
production.description: Issue production orders, execute batches against master formulas, receive raw materials and respond to IoT alerts.
production.headline: Batches executed against approved master formulas

administration.label: Administration environment
administration.name: Administration
administration.description: Manage the organization and its plants, invite users, assign roles and manage the subscription.
administration.headline: One organization, the right access for every role

selection.title: Sign in to DoofPlus
selection.subtitle: Choose the environment you work in. Each environment shows the modules and approvals of its role.

sign-in.title: Sign in to the {{environment}} environment
sign-in.subtitle: Use your work account. Next, you will confirm your identity with a two-factor code.
sign-in.invalid-title: The email or password is incorrect.
sign-in.invalid-text: Check your credentials and try again. After 5 failed attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.
sign-in.access-note: Access is granted by the role your laboratory administrator assigned.
sign-in.two-factor-text: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to confirm that you are {{name}} ({{email}}).
sign-in.code-hint: Codes refresh every 30 seconds. After 5 failed attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.
sign-in.invalid-code: The code is not valid. Enter the current code of your authenticator app.
sign-in.denied-title: Access not authorized for this environment
sign-in.denied-text: Your identity was verified, but your role ({{role}}) does not grant access to the {{environment}} environment. Ask your laboratory administrator to review your role, or continue in your own environment.

users.subtitle: Assign least-privilege profiles and review access by facility.
users.two-factor-text: Sessions expire after 15 minutes of inactivity.
users.deactivation-text: Signed records and attributed events are never deleted.
users.rbac-text: Only authenticated users with assigned roles and facility scope can access functions. Choosing a public segment never grants access.
users.sent-text: {{email}} appears in Invitations until the user verifies the email and enrolls 2FA.

invite.title: Invite user
invite.subtitle: An organization administrator can invite users within the user limit of the plan (Standard Lab: 10 users; Enterprise: unlimited).
invite.duplicate: The user already belongs to this organization or has an invitation.
invite.state-pending: The user receives a verification link; access starts after email verification and 2FA enrollment.
invite.state-sent: The invited user appears in Users & profiles → Invitations.

subscriptions.subtitle: Manage your plan, payment method and invoice history. Payments are processed by Niubiz.
subscriptions.declined-text: The card was declined. The subscription stays Pending until a payment is approved.
subscriptions.no-change: Choose another plan or billing cycle to review the change.
subscriptions.cancellation: Cancellation policy: access continues through the end of the paid term. Export records before account closure.
subscriptions.no-card: No card registered yet. The first charge is requested after email verification.
subscriptions.state-declined-text: Niubiz declined the charge. The subscription stays Pending and the reason is shown.
subscriptions.state-upgrades-text: Only organization admins can confirm plan changes.
subscriptions.state-reminder-text: Sent to {{email}} 7 days before each renewal.

registration.headline: Clarity at every critical step.

intro.qa-text: Documents, deviations, CAPA and release decisions.
intro.production-text: Orders, batches, materials and equipment tracking.
intro.access-text: Organization profiles, assigned roles, facility scope and two-factor authentication. Email verification is required before workspace activation.
intro.permissions-text: The administrator role does not grant QA or release permissions. Roles and facility access are assigned after authentication and 2FA enrollment.

registration.title: Organization registration
registration.subtitle: Create the organization profile and designate its first administrator. An email verification link is sent before workspace activation.
registration.ruc-error: Enter a valid RUC: 11 digits starting with 10 or 20.
registration.ruc-registered: This RUC is already registered. The organization already exists in DoofPlus — ask its administrator for an invitation.
registration.plan-limits: Up to {{devices}} IoT devices and {{users}} users · Paid with Niubiz after email verification
registration.plan-unlimited: Unlimited IoT devices and users · Paid with Niubiz after email verification
registration.administrator-name-error: Enter the name of the administrator.
registration.password-rule: At least 12 characters, including a number and a symbol.
registration.notice: An email verification link will be sent to {{email}} before your workspace is activated.
registration.accept-1: I have read and accept the
registration.accept-3: I understand that an email verification link will be sent to confirm my address.
registration.create-note: You will receive an email to verify your address.
registration.required: Required fields. Your information is used only to set up this organization.
registration.verify-text: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Open it to activate the workspace; then sign in and enroll two-factor authentication.

profile.subtitle: Your personal data, area and notification preferences. Roles and plant access are assigned by your laboratory administrator.
profile.personal-data-text: Profile linked to your user account
profile.email-note: The work email identifies your account and cannot be changed here.
profile.notifications-text: How DoofPlus notifies you about tasks, critical deviations and IoT alerts
profile.email-notifications-text: Critical deviations, approval requests and release decisions are sent to your work email.
profile.in-app-text: Tasks and alerts appear in the notification bell and in your task inbox.
profile.language-text: English (en-US) is the default; Spanish (es-419) is available for every screen.
profile.security: Two-factor authentication is active on your account. Your password is also used to confirm electronic signatures; a new password must be at least 12 characters long.

overview.subtitle: Organization access, platform adoption and account health.

products.title: Products & master formulas
products.subtitle: Manage the product catalog and the approved master formula each batch is manufactured with.
products.catalog-text: {{count}} products · only products with an approved master formula can start new batches
products.new-text: Master data required to manufacture new batches
products.name: Product name
products.code-error: Use two letters and three digits, such as AC500.
products.duplicate: Code {{code}} already exists. Use a unique product code.
products.no-components: This version has no components yet.
products.protected: Approved formulas are protected: any change creates a new version that must be approved before it can be used in a batch. Formulas without components or with non-positive quantities are rejected.

batches.subtitle: Track manufacturing status, quality gates and distribution readiness.
batches.definition-hold-text: An incident or quality gate pauses execution.
batches.definition-release-text: Only authorized QA can sign the final release.
batches.rejected-title: The batch could not be registered

rejected.formula-not-approved: A batch can only be created for a product whose master formula is approved ({{product}} has no approved formula).

orders.subtitle: Orders issued against approved master formulas.
orders.hold-alert: {{operation}} is on hold because of {{reference}}. Only containment and incident records can be added until QA authorizes the restart.
orders.execution-text: Operations of the effective master formula
orders.formula-text: Locked · changes require a new approved version · approved
orders.not-found: No production order matches that code.

receipt.title: Raw-material receipt
receipt.subtitle: receiving and quarantine inspection
receipt.alert: Material is unavailable for production. New receipts enter quarantine; Quality must approve them before they are allocated to a production order.
receipt.record-note: Recording moves the material to Sampling.
receipt.disposition-text: A QA/QC specialist submits the analytical results and an authorized quality manager approves or rejects the lot. A rejection requires a reason and keeps the stock segregated.
